threads.body: [Style] `getClient` is `protected static` but both classes are in the same package, so package-private (`static`) is sufficient and more consistent with the established codebase convention. See e.g. `apache-httpclient-2.0/AbstractCommonsHttpClientTest.java:46`, `apache-httpclient-4.3/AbstractApacheHttpClientTest.java:52`, and `apache-httpclient-5.2/AbstractApacheHttpClientTest.java:50` which all use package-private `getClient` methods for the same subclass-access pattern.
